description: This file contains type definitions for AWS Bedrock Invoke Agent API responses, including dictionaries representing headers, events, traces, payloads, and other related data structures. It defines various TypedDict classes used for modeling API response data and internal event representations.

classes.name: InvokeAgentEventHeaders
classes.description: Headers for AWS Invoke Agent events, including event type, content type, and message type.

classes.name: InvokeAgentUsage
classes.description: Contains token usage information from trace events, including input/output token counts and optional model name.

classes.name: InvokeAgentMetadata
classes.description: Metadata from a model invocation, including request timing, client request ID, and usage details.

classes.name: InvokeAgentModelInvocationInput
classes.description: Details of model invocation input, including model name, configuration, text, trace ID, and type.

classes.name: InvokeAgentModelInvocationOutput
classes.description: Details of model invocation output, including metadata, response content, reasoning, and trace ID.

classes.name: InvokeAgentOrchestrationTrace
classes.description: Contains orchestration trace information with optional model invocation input/output.

classes.name: InvokeAgentPreProcessingTrace
classes.description: Contains pre-processing trace information with optional model invocation input/output.

classes.name: InvokeAgentTrace
classes.description: Container for various trace information, including orchestration and pre-processing traces.

classes.name: InvokeAgentCallerChain
classes.description: Represents caller chain information with an agent alias ARN.

classes.name: InvokeAgentTracePayload
classes.description: Payload for trace events, including agent identifiers, caller chain, event time, session ID, and trace data.

classes.name: InvokeAgentChunkPayload
classes.description: Payload for chunk events containing base64-encoded response bytes.

classes.name: InvokeAgentEventPayload
classes.description: Union type for event payloads, accommodating both trace and chunk event data.

classes.name: InvokeAgentEvent
classes.description: Complete structure for AWS Invoke Agent responses, including headers and optional payload.

methods.name: InvokeAgentEventList
methods.description: Type alias for a list of InvokeAgentEvent instances.

methods.name: InvokeAgentTraceEvent
methods.description: Type alias specifically for trace events (same as InvokeAgentEvent).

methods.name: InvokeAgentChunkEvent
methods.description: Type alias specifically for chunk events (same as InvokeAgentEvent).
